scope: Three changed files: FFN-only ops caller, dedicated RMS local-BF16 output helper, and cluster0 sharded quantizer/compatibility wrapper. adoption.reason: This single allocation did not show a net gain. Preserve it; root decides whether a concrete unresolved variance or implementation issue justifies another check.

further_tuning.reason: 5% is a provisional additional-tuning budget, not an adoption minimum. No tile sweep is authorized by this report.

major_research.question: Does keeping original pre-RMS H480 output shards through cluster0 quantization eliminate early canonical gather/replication dependencies once globalMax, late packed CL2 copy and retained ring32/TRF costs are included? No overlapping interval is a saving promise.
